_comment: Curated flagship brand names → parent, seeding aliases.kind='brand' so the Library subtitle and 'Also known as' lead with the name people actually know (D.1.7 — Specs/psid-identity-consumption.md). Purely a display-ordering hint: kind drives no fold, no facet, no dose. Scope is deliberately the famous BASE-form brands the form maps don't already enumerate — release brands (Concerta, Adderall XR) come from release-families.json `brands[]` and isomer brands (Focalin, Spravato) from isomer-families.json `variants[].brands`, both tagged 'brand' by annotate_alias_facets() too, so they need not be repeated here. Ambiguous combination brands (Vicodin/Percocet/Norco → two parents) are omitted; search disambiguates by substances.popularity. Every `brand` must already exist as an alias of its `parent` (verified 2026-07-16); a miss is reported by the build's coverage gate, not failed, since available sources vary by build.
